notes: Obligations: 42 items in each version, systematic sample k=2 (indices 0,2,...,40; 21 judged per version). Reference excludes procedural time limits (72 h, 60 days, 30 days, 3 months, 1 month, 6-month audit/report) as key dates; both versions code them as deadline events, which the codebook allows, and they were judged correct. Both versions share the Senate/House date error: the bill schedule's extracted text reads '3rd May, 2023. (4) Date Passed by the Senate 24th May, 2023. (5) Date Passed by the House of Representatives', where every other column of the schedule (short title, long title, summary) prints the value before its label, so 3 May = Senate and 24 May = House. Unsampled items noted but not counted: Y O37 (s.49 offence coded as a prohibition obligation) and Y O39 (s.53(1) culpability coded as an obligation) look unsupported; X O3 (s.25 lawful bases as 'other' obligation) is borderline. Text inconsistency in s.13(2) (offence names paras (b),(e); penalties name (b),(d)): Y flags it, X lists (b),(d),(e) without flagging.
